subject: System Design
title: API Gateways
description: A micro-lesson that makes API Gateways usable.

hook.text: Your mobile app calls 8 microservices to render one screen. An API gateway reduces that to one call.

buildup.text: An API gateway aggregates multiple backend calls into a single response for the client.

discovery.text: It also handles authentication, rate limiting, logging, and request transformation centrally.

twist.text: The gateway itself must scale and not become the bottleneck. It's a critical infrastructure component.

climax.text: API gateways simplify client communication at the cost of adding a central dependency.

punchline.text: One door in, many services behind it.

quiz.question: What does an API gateway do?
options: Aggregates multiple backend calls into one response
